items.title: Obtain and renew a Little Rock business license
items.authority: City of Little Rock Treasury Management Division
items.description: Businesses in Little Rock need a city business license, applied for after zoning approval, with a fee based on the number of employees or the amount of inventory. Licenses renew each year on January 1; an account not paid by February 1 is charged a 10% penalty, another 10% if not paid by March 1, and 30% if not paid by April 1. A business that closes before July 1 may ask in writing for a refund of half the fee.
items.deadlineNote: to avoid the penalty; licenses renew January 1
